# RaggieSoft Showcase Studio v0.5.0 — Quick AI Reference (llms.txt)

- **Stack**: 100% Zero-Dependency Static `/MT` Win32 C++20 (`x64` & `ARM64`)
- **Binaries**: `ShowcaseStudio.exe` (Visual Canvas & 4-Way Focus IDE), `rssbuild.exe` (CLI Compiler & WCAG Validator), `ShowcaseStub.exe` (`< 1 MB` Runtime), `RaggieSoftHelp.exe` (`F1` Viewer)
- **Manifest**: `.rssp` (Comment-preserving INI AST) + optional `.rssc` (`RaggieScript` v1.0 `RSWBC2`)
- **Presentation Styles**: `retro_bmp95` | `fluentmica_16x9` | `kiosk_fullscreen`
- **Media Layouts**: `single_exe` (solid `LZMS` `RSSPAK01` `#320` + `_support\` `#321`) | `disc_folder` (`+ autorun.inf`)
- **Editions**: `Community == 100% Architect Parity` (Free) • `Essentials` • `Developer` (`+ RaggieScript`) • `Architect` (`+ _support\ Bespoke Installers, Suite Front-Door, Kiosk & Auto-VPAT 2.5`)

## Canonical `.rssp` Section & Key Reference

```ini
[Showcase]
Title                   = RaggieSoft Collector's Box Set
Subtitle                = Accessible 1990s .BMP & Windows 11 FluentMica Launchpad
Version                 = 1.0.0
Publisher               = RaggieSoft
PresentationStyle       = retro_bmp95          ; retro_bmp95 | fluentmica_16x9 | kiosk_fullscreen
MediaLayout             = single_exe           ; single_exe | disc_folder
CanvasSize              = 800x600
IntegerPixelScale       = true
BackdropWash            = #008080
AccentPrimaryHex        = #2563EB
AutoPlayAudio           = false                ; Enforced false by default (WCAG 1.4.2)
RequestedExecutionLevel = asInvoker            ; asInvoker | highestAvailable | requireAdministrator | deferred
RaggieScriptFile        = showcase.rssc        ; Optional (Developer / Architect / Community)
SupportDir              = _support             ; Optional Bespoke Installer payload (Architect / Community)
OutputName              = CollectorShowcase

[Page.MainMenu]
Title                   = Collector Showcase Menu
HighContrastTitle       = Collector Showcase — Main Menu
BackgroundBitmap        = art/main-800x600.bmp

[Hotspot.InstallSuite]
Page                    = MainMenu
Shape                   = rect                 ; rect | polygon
Bounds                  = 264, 110, 496, 62    ; Or Points = x1,y1; x2,y2; x3,y3 for polygon
Label                   = &1. Install Desktop Suite
Subtitle                = Launches signed x64 and ARM64 Setup.exe
Description             = Launches the signed application suite installer.
Action                  = run_installer        ; goto_page | run_installer | open_booklet | open_slides | play_audio | open_folder | open_document | run_script | install_support | exit
Target                  = packages/suite-setup.exe
FocusDown               = OpenBooklet
```

## Diagnostic Codes (`RSS001`–`RSS095`)
- `RSS001`–`RSS005`: Manifest syntax, `@include`, or missing `[Page]`/`[Hotspot]`
- `RSS010`: Hotspot missing screen-reader `Label` (WCAG 4.1.2)
- `RSS012` / `RSS013`: Missing or duplicate `&` `Alt+Key` mnemonic on page
- `RSS015`–`RSS017`: Broken 4-way focus ID, `goto_page`, or `open_booklet` target
- `RSS018`: Hotspot `< 24x24` px or polygon `< 3` vertices (WCAG 2.5.8)
- `RSS022`: Slide missing `AltText` (WCAG 1.1.1)
- `RSS030`: `AutoPlayAudio = true` violation (WCAG 1.4.2)
- `RSS032`–`RSS034`: Missing/invalid `.vtt` captions or `> 22 CPS` cue speed
- `RSS055`: Brand accent contrast warning
- `RSS091`–`RSS095`: Edition capability gate (`Community == 100% Architect Parity`)
